purpose: Teach: めど/取組み/先着/借入金/略称/一級/推察/親密

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文完成のめどはいつだ?
lines.en: Ren — when do you expect to have the paper finished?
lines.style: Direct but not cold. Clear expectation underneath. Measured pace. Slightly forward-leaning posture in the voice — a mentor checking in, not demanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究取組みの中間報告を準備しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing an interim report on the research progress.
lines.style: Careful, formal register. Steady delivery. Slight tension in the shoulders of the voice — wanting to demonstrate he's on top of things. No filler, just facts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究セミナーは先着順だ
lines.en: Ren — the research seminar is first-come, first-served.
lines.style: Factual, matter-of-fact. Not harsh, but the implication is clear: waiting won't help you. Brief pause after the dash. Pragmatic tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の借入金返済も計画しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm also planning how to manage the research fund loan repayment.
lines.style: Slightly faster than before, a touch of anxiety underneath. Still formal and polite. The words come out carefully arranged, like he's thought through each one.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の略称を統一しろ
lines.style: Crisp instruction. The tone of someone who has seen this detail overlooked before. Brief, purposeful. No softening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。一級資格取得を目指しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm aiming to obtain my first-class certification.
lines.style: Earnest but a bit scattered. He's listing things, trying to show he's managing. Slight quaver of doubt underneath — is this what was being asked?

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、審査員のお気持ちを推察しろ
lines.en: Ren — try to understand what the reviewers are thinking.
lines.style: Slower, more intentional. This is the real advice underneath. Not impatient, but weighted. The pause before this line matters — this is the point.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室との親密な協力関係を築きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll build a stronger, more collaborative relationship with the lab.
lines.style: Nod of understanding in the voice. Warmer now — he's heard what was actually being said. Slight exhale. Steadier and more grounded than before.
